context.notes: Concrete block retaining wall next to a tree.

result.summary: A severe vertical structural crack and full section separation observed in a concrete block retaining wall, likely driven by tree root expansion and differential settlement.

findings.location: Vertical interface at the stepped junction of the concrete block retaining wall
probable_causes: Tree root expansion and soil displacement from adjacent mature tree
Lack of engineered expansion or movement joints
recommended_actions: Consult a structural or geotechnical engineer for wall stability evaluation
Assess tree root impact with an arboricultural professional
Install calibrated tell-tale crack monitoring gauges
Rebuild the displaced wall section incorporating proper movement joints and drainage

result.monitoring_plan: Affix tell-tale crack gauges across the separation and take monthly measurements and scaled photographs to track active displacement.
result.limitations: Visual inspection limited to a single photograph; foundation details, internal wall reinforcement, and soil conditions cannot be verified.
